findings.issue: 何分 (how many minutes) is read なんぷん, not なんふん — the counter 分 takes the p-sound after ん (さんぷん, なんぷん). Romaji 'nanfun' should likewise be 'nanpun'.
findings.current: えきえわたくしーでなんふんくらいかかりますか。
findings.suggested: えきえわたくしーでなんぷんくらいかかりますか。

findings.issue: Token 分 in 何分 must read ぷん (handakuon after ん, as in さんぷん/なんぷん); ふん is a wrong reading in this context.
映画作り as a compound noun takes rendaku: えいがづくり (like ものづくり, まちづくり, てづくり). えいがつくり is a wrong reading. Romaji 'eigatsukuri' should be 'eigazukuri'.
findings.current: えいがつくりわひとをわくわくさせるしごとだ。
findings.suggested: えいがづくりわひとをわくわくさせるしごとだ。

findings.issue: Token 作り as second element of the compound 映画作り is read づくり (rendaku), not つくり.

The English note on せる glosses おこさせる as 'to make [someone] wake up' — the wrong sense of 起こす for this sentence (やる気をおこさせる = make motivation arise). The pt-BR note ('fazer despertar') has the correct sense; en contradicts it.
findings.current: auxiliary せる forming the causative おこさせる ("to make [someone] wake up")
findings.suggested: auxiliary せる forming the causative おこさせる ("to make (motivation) arise")

findings.issue: Accent typo: 'continuo' should be 'contínuo'. The same typo appears in this token's pt-BR note ('estado continuo').
Malformed text: 'conversa(o)bjeto' is a mangled 'conversa (objeto)' — misplaced parenthesis makes the gloss unreadable; missing space before '(ser-compreendida)' too.
Untranslated internal jargon in the pt-BR learner text: 'O foco coverage está...' mixes an English pipeline term into Portuguese; expl_en has 'The coverage focus'.
findings.current: O foco coverage está nessa combinação de partículas e na oração relativa que antecede o substantivo.
findings.suggested: O foco de cobertura está nessa combinação de partículas e na oração relativa que antecede o substantivo.

findings.issue: Internal token-index leak: "'の' (position 5)" uses a 0-based pipeline index that is meaningless to a reader (の is the 6th token) and is absent from expl_pt.
